name: Korean peninsula
summary: No North Korean missile launch found since 3 Nov; Kim calls for deploying battlefield nuclear weapons on 25 Nov
state: South Korea reported a North Korean launch of multiple missiles on 3 Nov, the fourth weapons launch in a month (The Star). KCNA said Kim Jong Un toured nuclear material production plants and a research institute up to 25 Nov and called for deploying low-yield battlefield nuclear weapons; Seoul's defence ministry said it takes the remarks seriously (AP via KPBS). No missile launch in the past two weeks, nuclear test or border clash was found to 27 Nov, so Normal holds.
for_you: No immediate change for travellers or residents. Follow FCDO travel advice for South Korea.
